sections.title: Basic Concepts of Geometry
sections.content: Geometry is the branch of mathematics that deals with shapes, sizes, lines, angles, triangles, circles, polygons, etc. It is based on visualization and measurement.

sections.title: Shapes and Their Types
sections.content: Main shapes: Triangle, Quadrilateral, Circle, Polygon. Each shape has its own properties. For example, the sum of angles in a triangle is 180°.

sections.title: Basic Formulas
sections.content:
Triangle area = 1/2 × base × height
Circle area = π × r²
Circle circumference = 2 × π × r
Quadrilateral area = length × width

sections.title: Key Properties and Identification
sections.content: Identify right-angled triangles, isosceles triangles, symmetric polygons, and the center, radius, and diameter of circles. Understand relationships between angles and sides.

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content: Assuming sum of triangle angles ≠ 180°. Confusing radius and diameter in a circle. Mixing up area and perimeter formulas.

sections.title: Quick Summary
sections.content: Focus on shape identification, memorize basic formulas, understand angles and lengths correctly, and practice visualization to strengthen geometry skills.

tricks.title: Quickly find 10%
tricks.explanation: To find 10% of a number, divide it by 10.

tricks.title: Quickly find 50%
tricks.explanation: 50% of a number = half of the number.
